classification.experiment_only_rule: These files are evidence-generating qualification harnesses. Their control flow is not a production lifecycle contract and must never be promoted wholesale as the Phase 2 backend.

validated_primitive_assets_reusable_by_c.role: canonical CPU EXEC148 transform and validators

missing_before_audit: one concrete BackendAdapter that owns Q4 Vulkan representation state and obeys v4 acquisition/lifecycle decisions
one backend-bound real-weight execution probe routed through generic policy -> generic binding -> concrete adapter

research/arcllm-v1-q4down-splitk-causal.reason: duplicate-scope descendant; not the source of the current Q4 4-arm harness

root_cause_of_late_detection: The Q4 4-arm harness was correct for factorial experimentation but was later used as a real-backend probe even though B1 and Phase 2 explicitly recorded production runtime wiring as incomplete. No backend source changed; the semantic role assigned to the harness was incorrect.

required_actions: A/NONE: resolve and execute A without allocating EXEC148
ACQUIRE/P1: allocate exactly 549527552 bytes, perform exact GPU in-place transform, then validate identity before B readiness
ACQUIRE/P3: load only an externally valid pre-materialized sidecar when selected and available
ACQUIRE/P0: allocate exactly 549527552 bytes and perform exact CPU direct transform when selected
B resident/NONE: reuse existing B without reacquisition
EVICT: release B before continuing on A
backend failures return to generic binding without hidden retry/fallback
